reason: I use AI all day at work, but I don't let it move my money, and a cartoon pet deciding my trades makes the whole thing feel like a game. I'm not joining a waitlist for a paid plan with no price and no named broker behind it.
objection: Handing an AI agent the ability to invest and pay on my behalf, even within limits, and dressing it up as a Tamagotchi makes it feel unserious with real money.
would_change_my_mind: A named, licensed broker holding my account with real insurance, and a mode where the agent only suggests trades and never executes without my tap.
